title: docs(pm-dispatch): hang the keys beside the contract-review gate (discoverability only)
body:
Fixes #11335

## What this is

Discoverability text only — hanging the keys beside the `needs:contract-review` gate. The card's operative scope is the grading comment: the review-chain mechanism, the seat-session fuse, the value and semantics of `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, and who may clear the label are all explicitly untouched (the mechanism was confirmed correct by the card's own four independent reproductions).

## The four edits

1. **`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`** — one JSDoc line beside `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` pointing at the SKILL.md rulebook (the 「入队与落地」 clause-② gate + the `needs:contract-review` review-chain bullets). The seat greps the constant; the constant now says where its rulebook lives. No behavior change; the script's self-test stays green (`✓ dispatch-gates self-test: 557 cases pass.`).
2. **`SKILL.md`, the 「保险丝只对座位自会话有效」 passage** — the subagent clause now reads 「subagent 的实际服役档位现无法对 `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` 自证」, so a grep for the constant lands on the operative sentence. In-sentence, line-neutral.
3. **Same passage** — one loud anti-pattern sentence appended in-line: 「**⛔ 反模式:派更高档位子 agent 去执行契约复审** —— 看似满足档位,实为构造上不可测量(多次实测:子代理读回父会话档位并拒绝出裁决)。」 In-sentence, line-neutral.
4. **`SKILL.md` 「平台读数纪律」** — one situation-index line: 「**GitHub 限流 ⇒ 先 `GET /rate_limit`(零配额)取精确 reset 与余量,⛔ 不盲等**;公开仓降级 WebFetch 读法与限流细则见 platform-readings。」 Detail stays in references; both remedies verified present in `references/platform-readings.md`.

## Ratchet payment (SKILL.md at 682/682, headroom 0)

Ratchet verdict quoted from the mechanical-guard index: 「本文件行数只降不升(`pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet`);抬上限需维护者裁决引用在 PR 正文;⛔ re-wrap(折行合并)不得用作筹行 —— 棘轮治理的是内容体量,行数只是机读代理,新增以删减付账;密度优化仅随净减内容的 PR 顺带(维护者 2026-08-17 授权席裁)」.

- **Added**: 1 line (edit 4). Edits 2–3 are in-sentence and line-neutral as scoped.
- **Paid by**: deleting the Guardrails clause 「每个 dev agent 都在**每仓专属的自有 worktree** 里干活(hook 强制;os-dev 定义重申);」 and merging its bullet from 3 physical lines to 2. Least load-bearing by the grading's own preference criterion: the clause **self-declared** its redundancy — it is mechanically enforced (`guard-main-checkout` hooks), restated in the os-dev agent definition, and still carried inside this file by the mechanical-guard index row (`guard-main-checkout` / `guard-shared-stash` hooks | worktree-first 与 stash 禁令的机械面). The line saving is realized at the deletion point, not by re-wrapping untouched text; the bullet's remaining content (batch cap, file-face disjointness, seat rules) is unchanged.
- **Mechanical provenance check** (standard the lane held PR #11334 to): date inventory (`grep -o` of `20xx-xx-xx`, uniq-counted) and bracketed-quote inventory (`grep -o '「[^」]*」'`, sorted) taken before and after — **both byte-identical** (19 distinct dates; 63 quotes). No dated ruling or verbatim quote deleted; the new lines add no dates and no bracketed quotes.
- Result: `✓ check-skill-line-ratchet: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md is 682 lines (ceiling 682; headroom 0).`
